entities.name: Elspeth Tyrel
entities.description: A planeswalker who writes a letter to Ajani from a temple on Theros after escaping Mirrodin's fall.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker and friend to whom Elspeth addresses her letter.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker immune to the Phyrexian contagion who fights beside Elspeth and sends her away.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A young Mirran who provided immunity to the Phyrexian contagion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure who left Mirrodin, after which the resistance briefly had hope.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An interloper among the praetors, despised by them.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor believed to have dominated Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, one of the gods of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, one of the gods of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor whose domain Elesh Norn was believed to have dominated.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose schematics for a Phyrexian-inspired ship were used to modify the spellbomb.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god of the sun on Theros, whose form Elspeth saw when she got her sword.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A Theros god of potions and poison to whom prayers are sunk in a swamp.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: The Phyrexian rulers of New Phyrexia, regarded by Elspeth as its gods.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexians, whose contagion engulfed Mirrodin and spreads like a bloodstain.

entities.name: Mirrodin Resistance
entities.description: The Mirran resistance against Phyrexia, which is lost by the finale.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane engulfed by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Elspeth recovers in a temple cave.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place where Koth encountered Venser building a Phyrexian ship.

entities.name: Butcher Hall
entities.description: A hall crossed to reach the secret execution chamber in the praetors' cathedral-fortress.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Obliterator
entities.description: A Phyrexian abomination designed solely to kill; one kills Elspeth's wounded body in the chamber.

events.summary: Elspeth writes a letter to Ajani, intending to sink it in a swamp as a prayer.
events.quote: I'm going to roll the parchment up, slide it into a ceramic vial, and sink it in a swamp.

events.summary: Elspeth arrives on Theros in a bleak swamp and is cared for by snake-loving priests in a cave temple.
events.quote: When I arrived this time, I ended up in a bleak swamp near an entrance to a cave.
You know that Phyrexia reared up and engulfed the metal plane.

events.summary: Melira provides immunity to the Phyrexian contagion.
events.quote: a young Mirran named Melira provided us with a natural immunity to the Phyrexian contagion

events.summary: The praetors despise the interloper Tezzeret and squabble among themselves.
events.quote: But they all began to despise the interloper, Tezzeret.

events.summary: The resistance focuses on destroying Elesh Norn, believing she dominated other praetors' domains.
events.quote: So we focused our energies on destroying her.

events.summary: The resistance is lost and its final stand begins.
Elspeth and Koth infiltrate the praetors' cathedral-fortress.
events.quote: Koth and I managed to infiltrate their cathedral-fortress

events.summary: Koth's spellbomb, modified with Venser's schematics, is placed beneath the new throne room.
events.quote: We'd modified it using Venser's schematics.

events.summary: The praetors gather to select a new Father or Mother of Machines.
events.quote: the praetors were gathering in the throne room to select a new Father—or Mother—of Machines

events.summary: Phyrexians break at the sealed door; Koth sets the spellbomb.
Koth tells Elspeth she is leaving and that there is nothing to come back for.
events.quote: Seal this world off, and throw away the key.

events.summary: Flashback: Koth encased Venser's head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
events.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

events.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth to her knees in stone and raises a wall between them.
events.quote: he just sunk me up to my knees in the stone and left me there

events.summary: An Obliterator breaks in and stabs Elspeth.
events.quote: two of its blades drove deep into my belly

events.summary: Koth's spellbomb explodes on the other side of the wall.
events.quote: Koth's spellbomb exploded on the other side of his makeshift wall

events.summary: Elspeth remembers Heliod and planeswalks to Theros.
events.quote: My blood rushed out of me as I left that nightmare world.

events.summary: Elspeth resolves to stay in the temple until she understands the gods of Theros.
events.quote: I am resolved to stay here until I understand the nature of the world and its divine stewards.

relations.note: Fought together on Mirrodin and pledged to die rather than be taken.
relations.quote: we promised each other we'd kill ourselves before they could take us apart limb from limb while we were still alive

relations.note: Elspeth writes to Ajani as a trusted friend.
relations.quote: When you look at me, you see all that I could be.

relations.note: Koth forced Venser to planeswalk away from Urborg.
relations.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
But they all began to despise the interloper, Tezzeret.

relations.note: Named among the gods of New Phyrexia.
Named among the gods of New Phyrexia.
Named among the gods of New Phyrexia.
Elspeth saw Heliod the day she got her sword.
relations.quote: I saw him the day I got my sword.

relations.note: The resistance focused on destroying her.
relations.quote: So we focused our energies on destroying her.
